about.metaDescription: IHUI AI is an all-in-one full-stack AI operating system that integrates an Agent marketplace, knowledge base RAG, multi-model unified scheduling, and the MCP tool protocol. It supports six-end homology across Web / Desktop / Mini Program / Browser Extension / React Native / CLI, open source under Apache 2.0.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.ch1Body: IHUI-AI ("the Platform") provides AI model relay, API gateway, and developer tool services. The Platform aggregates multiple upstream AI model providers (including but not limited to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and 93 providers), offering unified API calling interfaces, key management, and billing services for developers. By using the Platform's services, you agree to all terms herein.
terms.ch2Body: Users must provide true, accurate, and complete personal information during registration. Users shall safeguard their account passwords and bear all losses caused by improper account management. Administrator (admin) accounts must not abuse their privileges or access or modify other users' data without authorization. Registering multiple accounts for improper purposes is prohibited.
terms.ch3Body: When using the Platform's API relay service, users must ensure they have lawfully obtained authorization to use upstream API Keys. Bypassing the Platform to directly call upstream APIs is prohibited. Under the BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model, the Platform charges a service fee of 5%-20% of API call volume. Users must comply with the Platform's rate limit restrictions; excessive calls will be throttled or suspended.
terms.ch4Body: The Platform offers API subscriptions, redemption codes, wallet top-ups, and other paid services. Subscriptions may be refunded within 7 days if unused; redemption codes are non-refundable once used; wallet top-up amounts have no expiration. All fees are non-refundable upon payment, except for the refund scenarios above. Prices are subject to the Platform's real-time display.
terms.ch5Body: The Platform's source code, interface design, trademarks, and other intellectual property rights belong to the project owner. User-uploaded content belongs to the user. AI model-generated content belongs to the user, but the user must ensure lawful and compliant use of generated content and must not infringe on third-party intellectual property rights.
terms.ch6Body: The Platform's services must not be used for: illegal activities, infringing on others' rights, abusing API resources, bulk data scraping, reselling API Keys, bypassing rate limits, reverse engineering the Platform's interfaces, etc. The Platform reserves the right to immediately suspend or terminate services upon discovering violations.
terms.ch7Body: The Platform reserves the right to change service plans, adjust pricing, and suspend or terminate part or all services at any time. Users may cancel subscriptions at any time; services remain valid until the end of the current billing cycle and will not renew upon expiration.
terms.ch8Body: AI-generated content does not constitute professional advice (legal, medical, financial, etc.); users should make their own judgments and bear usage risks. The Platform does not guarantee the continuous availability of upstream APIs and is not liable for losses caused by upstream service interruptions. The Platform is not liable for data loss caused by force majeure or system failures.
terms.ch9Body: These terms are governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China. Disputes arising from these terms shall first be resolved through negotiation; if negotiation fails, the matter shall be submitted to the Beijing Arbitration Commission for arbitration under its arbitration rules.
terms.ch10Body: If you have any questions about these terms, please contact: support@ihui.ai.

usagePolicy.title: Usage Policy
usagePolicy.s1Body: Users shall use the Platform's services on the premise of legality, compliance, and authorization. Users must comply with local laws and regulations and the service terms of upstream API providers.
usagePolicy.s2Body: The services must not be used for: illegal activities, infringing on others' intellectual property or privacy, harassing others, abusing API resources, reverse engineering the Platform's API interfaces, bulk account registration, etc. Violations will be handled immediately.
usagePolicy.s3Body: Using the Platform to generate illegal, pornographic, violent, infringing, or false information is prohibited. Users are responsible for the legality of generated content and must label AI-generated content in accordance with applicable regulations.
usagePolicy.s4Body: Users must comply with the Platform's QPS limits. Reselling API Keys and bypassing billing mechanisms are prohibited. The Platform retains call logs for 30 days for billing and security audits, with automatic deletion upon expiration.
usagePolicy.s5Body: Violations will be handled by severity: warning → service suspension → account termination → legal action. In serious cases, the Platform will cooperate with judicial authorities in investigations.

serviceSpecificTerms.title: Service-Specific Terms
serviceSpecificTerms.s1Body: Users must ensure they have lawfully obtained authorization to use upstream API Keys. The Platform does not store API Key plaintext and uses AES-256-GCM encryption. Under the BYOK model, the Platform charges a service fee of 5%-20% of API call volume.
serviceSpecificTerms.s2Body: The Platform aggregates 898 models from 93 providers. Model availability depends on upstream providers, and the Platform does not guarantee all models remain continuously available. Model prices adjust with upstream changes, subject to the Platform's real-time display.
serviceSpecificTerms.s3Body: Redemption codes are 16-digit unique codes valid for 90 days. Once used, codes are non-refundable and cannot be resold. Expired codes automatically become invalid and will not be reissued.
serviceSpecificTerms.s4Body: Subscription services support auto-renewal. Cancellation takes effect immediately; fees for the current paid billing cycle are non-refundable, and services remain valid until the cycle expires.
serviceSpecificTerms.s5Title: Generative AI Service Management Compliance Notice
serviceSpecificTerms.s5Body: Per the Interim Measures for the Management of Generative Artificial Intelligence Services (effective August 15, 2023), users are responsible for AI-generated content, must label AI-generated content per regulations, and must not use generative AI services for illegal activities.
